title: The 12 Best Griddles
metaDescription: Our 12 picks for griddles, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at griddles using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Blackstone 28-Inch Griddle Combo
products.blurb: Key specs: 470 sq in cooking surface, Dual burner zones, Propane powered.
strengths: 470 sq in, the largest surface for most households
Dual independent burner zones for simultaneous different temperatures
Reaches and holds 400°F+ for smash burgers and searing
limitations: Propane-fueled outdoor griddle, not a countertop electric, needs patio/deck space
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Presto 07046 Tilt 'n Drain Big Griddle
products.blurb: Key specs: Tilt drain, 240 sq in, Under $40.
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Cuisinart GR-300WS Griddler Elite
products.blurb: Key specs: Reversible plates, Grill and griddle, Dishwasher safe.
strengths: Reversible dishwasher-safe plates: flat griddle on one side, ridged grill on the other
Versatile, griddle, grill, panini press, and full-open flat
limitations: 200 sq in per side (400 sq in total open)
